Using HaruCa You need a balance of at least ¥170 to enter. If your balance does not cover the fare when you leave, pay the difference at the fare adjustment machine inside the gate. Exit within 3 hours of entering. Otherwise the gate stops you and staff will charge the fare from your entry station. HaruCa can be used on Harukawa City Bus and Tsukimi Bus, and in shops inside our stations. It cannot be used on the airport limousine bus. IC cards issued by other railways in Japan cannot be used on Harukawa Railway, and HaruCa cannot be used outside Minori Prefecture. A card with a commuter pass on it is refunded under the commuter pass rules. If you lose a HaruCa A Personalized HaruCa, Child HaruCa, HaruCa Commuter or HaruCa Assist can be stopped and reissued. Report the loss at a ticket office with ID; the balance is protected from that moment. The new card is ready from 10:00 the next day at the same office, for a reissue fee of ¥520 and a new ¥500 deposit. An unregistered HaruCa cannot be reissued. What is the cheapest fare? ¥170 with a paper ticket or ¥168 with HaruCa, for up to 3 km. See the fare table . Q. Can I use my IC card from Tokyo or Osaka? No. Only HaruCa can be used on Harukawa Railway. Please buy a paper ticket or a HaruCa. Q. Can I pay by credit card? Only at reserved-seat ticket machines (purple) and ticket offices. Regular ticket machines take cash and HaruCa only. HaruCa itself can be charged by credit card on HaruCa Web. Q. How do I get my HaruCa deposit back? Return the card at a ticket office. You get the balance minus ¥220 plus the ¥500 deposit. Details . Q. My HaruCa balance was not enough when I arrived. What do I do? Use the fare adjustment machine inside the ticket gate, or ask staff. At unstaffed stations, pay on the platform reader or report it at the next staffed station. Q. Is there a pass for one day? Yes: the 1-Day Free Pass, ¥1,300 on weekdays and ¥1,100 on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Details . Q. I travel the same route a few times a week. What is cheapest? Compare: HaruCa fares (cheapest per ride, and HaruCa Points from the 11th ride on the same section in a month), the 1-Day Free Pass on days with long return trips, and a commuter pass if you travel most days. A commuter pass usually pays off at around 14 or more round trips a month. Q. Do children need a ticket? Children aged 6–11 pay half fare. Up to two children aged 1–5 travel free with each paying passenger. Details . Q. Can I get a receipt? Ticket machines print a receipt on request (press "Receipt" before paying). For HaruCa journeys, print your use history at a ticket machine (last 20 journeys) or on HaruCa Web. Q. Is there a student discount? Only on commuter passes. Details . Tsukikage Q. Can I use a 1-Day Free Pass on Tsukikage? Yes, if you also buy the limited express surcharge. Q. Is there a toilet on Tsukikage? Yes, in Cars 2 (multipurpose) and 3. Travelling Q.
